headline: Unhanded apartments see 'dumping' sales; expert says many investors are stuck due to leverage
summary: Some Vietnamese apartment projects face a wave of dumping sales as buyers must pay the remaining 45% before handover. Floating loan rates of up to 14-15% a year are adding cash-flow pressure.
why: Real estate developers and mortgage lending are major parts of Vietnam's economy, and high borrowing costs affect property demand and prices.
